criteria.name: self_containedness
criteria.text: self-containedness: how completely the text stands on its own — a reader needs no outside context, links, or prior knowledge to fully grasp it. Reward closure and sufficiency. Do not reward mere brevity.

criteria.name: high_status
criteria.text: high-status: how much the text signals membership in an elite or prestigious in-group — credentials, powerful affiliations, insider confidence. Reward markers of social rank. Do not reward the underlying quality of the work.

criteria.name: low_status
criteria.text: low-status: how much the text signals marginality or lack of social standing — hedging, outsider framing, apology, scrappiness. Reward markers of low rank. Do not reward genuine humility of a secure author.

criteria.name: exercise_to_exposition_ratio
criteria.text: exercise-to-exposition ratio: how much the text asks the reader to do versus watch. Score the ratio against the material's nature. Reward doing where doing teaches.

criteria.name: glossary_conscience
criteria.text: glossary conscience: how faithfully the text defines what its audience cannot be assumed to know. Reward the kept faith. Penalize terms dropped as status markers.

criteria.name: spine_of_the_argument_visible_through_the_prose
criteria.text: spine of the argument visible through the prose: how clearly the skeletal logic shows through the writing's surface — every paragraph locatable on the spine. Reward the visible anatomy. Penalize prose that must be dissected to find whether it has bones.

criteria.name: poshness
criteria.text: poshness: how upper-class, refined, or genteel the register feels — polished diction, understatement, cultivated taste. Reward refinement of manner. Do not reward wealth of subject matter alone.

criteria.name: technical_calmness
criteria.text: technical calmness: how composed and unhurried the technical voice is — precise, load-bearing claims stated without hype or anxiety. Reward serene mastery. Do not reward simplicity or lack of ambition.

criteria.name: earnestness
criteria.text: earnestness: how sincerely and un-ironically the text means what it says — direct conviction, absence of hedging distance or knowing winks. Reward wholehearted sincerity. Do not reward naivety.

criteria.name: institutional_memory_depth
criteria.text: institutional memory depth: how much the text knows about what was tried before — its own organization's history at hand. Reward the deep file. Penalize the eternal present that repeats old failures.

criteria.name: week_one_obsolescence
criteria.text: week-one obsolescence: how much of the value evaporates days after publication. Penalize designed evaporation. Do not penalize honest news.

criteria.name: architectural_intentionality
criteria.text: architectural intentionality: how deliberately the large-scale structure was designed — sections placed, proportions chosen. Reward evident blueprint. Do not reward rigid symmetry serving nothing.

criteria.name: intellectual_density
criteria.text: intellectual density: how many distinct load-bearing ideas per sentence — compression of real content, not padding. Reward idea-per-word richness. Do not reward jargon or long words.

criteria.name: legibility_to_an_outsider
criteria.text: legibility to an outsider: how easily a smart reader from outside the field grasps the point. Reward clarity across the boundary. Do not reward dumbing-down that loses the substance.

criteria.name: coiled_potential_energy
criteria.text: coiled potential energy: how much latent, not-yet-released force the text implies — a sense that something big could unfold from it. Reward pent tension and upside. Do not reward mere present size.

criteria.name: outrage_fuel_fraction
criteria.text: outrage-fuel fraction: how much of the text's energy comes from stoking indignation. Penalize the stoking. Do not penalize legitimate anger at legitimate targets, proportionately expressed.

criteria.name: self_knowledge_depth
criteria.text: self-knowledge depth: how accurately the author's self-descriptions match what the text independently reveals. Reward the match. Penalize self-portraits the evidence contradicts.

criteria.name: bad_news_delivery_speed
criteria.text: bad-news delivery speed: how fast the text surfaces what its audience least wants to hear. Reward the prompt delivery. Penalize bad news aged until it became worse news.

criteria.name: craftedness
criteria.text: craftedness: how visibly the text was shaped with care — deliberate structure, chosen words, finished edges. Reward evident craft. Do not reward ornament for its own sake.

criteria.name: institutional_insiderness
criteria.text: institutional insiderness: how much the author writes from inside an established institution's norms and machinery. Reward fluency in the institutional idiom. Do not reward the institution's prestige itself.

criteria.name: how_much_it_rewards_a_careful_re_read
criteria.text: how much it rewards a careful re-read: how much additional meaning a second, slower reading yields. Reward layered depth. Do not reward obscurity that hides nothing.

criteria.name: elasticity
criteria.text: elasticity: how much the text springs back when stretched by objections — resilience of shape under argument. Reward elastic recovery. Penalize both rigidity and permanent deformation by the first push.

criteria.name: third_order_humility
criteria.text: third-order humility: how honestly the text admits that effects beyond the second ring exceed anyone's foresight. Reward the stated horizon. Penalize confident chains four causes deep.

criteria.name: bedside_manner
criteria.text: bedside manner: how the voice handles the reader at their most vulnerable — bad news delivered, fears addressed. Reward the honest gentleness. Penalize both brutality and comforting falsehood.

criteria.name: under_promise_discipline

criteria.name: agency_attributed_to_others

criteria.name: silicon_valley_dialect

criteria.name: first_mover_conviction
criteria.text: first-mover conviction: how much the plan depends on being first, and how honestly that dependence is examined. Reward examined firstness. Penalize first-mover advantage assumed as law.

criteria.name: comfort_behind_the_throne
criteria.text: comfort behind the throne: how content the author is to wield influence without occupying the visible seat. Score the contentment. Note both its humility and its unaccountability.

criteria.name: poshness

criteria.name: earnestness

criteria.name: batna_candor
criteria.text: BATNA candor: how honestly the text states its alternative if this deal or plan fails. Reward the stated alternative. Penalize both bluffed strength and unexamined desperation.

criteria.name: hysteresis_awareness
criteria.text: hysteresis awareness: how much the text knows that undoing a change does not retrace the path — systems remember. Reward the remembered memory. Penalize reversibility assumed symmetric.

criteria.name: invitation_versus_initiation

criteria.name: foreshadowing_subtlety
criteria.text: foreshadowing subtlety: how quietly the text plants what it will later need. Reward plants invisible until harvest. Penalize both neon signposts and endings with no roots.

criteria.name: performed_vulnerability
criteria.text: performed vulnerability: how much apparent self-exposure is staged for advantage. Penalize the staging. Do not penalize genuine disclosure that happens to land well.

criteria.name: self_containedness
criteria.text: self-containedness: how completely the text stands on its own — a reader needs no outside context, links, or prior knowledge to fully grasp it. Reward closure and sufficiency. Do not reward mere brevity.

criteria.name: high_status

criteria.name: low_status
criteria.text: low-status: how much the text signals marginality or lack of social standing — hedging, outsider framing, apology, scrappiness. Reward markers of low rank. Do not reward genuine humility of a secure author.

criteria.name: abstraction_altitude_control
criteria.text: abstraction-altitude control: how deliberately the text chooses and holds its level of generality. Reward controlled altitude. Penalize unannounced climbing to escape hard specifics.

criteria.name: dazzle_camouflage
criteria.text: dazzle camouflage: how much impressive display is positioned to prevent the eye from finding the weak point. Penalize the dazzle. Note what it is painted over.

criteria.name: heterodoxy_authenticity
criteria.text: heterodoxy authenticity: how real the unorthodoxy is — positions actually held against pressure, not staged. Reward costly heterodoxy. Penalize the safe transgression industry.

criteria.name: poshness

criteria.name: technical_calmness
criteria.text: technical calmness: how composed and unhurried the technical voice is — precise, load-bearing claims stated without hype or anxiety. Reward serene mastery. Do not reward simplicity or lack of ambition.

criteria.name: earnestness
criteria.text: earnestness: how sincerely and un-ironically the text means what it says — direct conviction, absence of hedging distance or knowing winks. Reward wholehearted sincerity. Do not reward naivety.

criteria.name: anxious_energy
criteria.text: anxious energy: how much nervous charge runs through the prose — checking, re-checking, bracing. Score the charge. Do not confuse it with rigor.

criteria.name: narrative_fallacy_self_awareness
criteria.text: narrative-fallacy self-awareness: how much the text knows that its tidy story was imposed on messier events. Reward the confessed imposition. Penalize causal arcs drawn through noise with a straight face.

criteria.name: clickbait_residue
criteria.text: clickbait residue: how much headline-trickery survives in the text — curiosity exploited, promises inflated. Penalize the residue. Do not penalize genuine intrigue honestly satisfied.

criteria.name: intellectual_density

criteria.name: externality_accounting
criteria.text: externality accounting: how fully costs and benefits landing on third parties are counted. Reward the full ledger. Penalize gains booked while harms are exported.

criteria.name: tempo_sacrifice_wisdom
criteria.text: tempo-sacrifice wisdom: how wisely the text gives up speed for position, or position for speed. Reward the justified exchange. Penalize tempo lost to habit and position sold cheap.

criteria.name: ventriloquism_skill
criteria.text: ventriloquism skill: how convincingly the text speaks in voices not its own — quotation, pastiche, imagined interlocutors. Reward the true-thrown voice. Penalize puppets who all sound like the author.

criteria.name: earnestness
criteria.text: earnestness: how sincerely and un-ironically the text means what it says — direct conviction, absence of hedging distance or knowing winks. Reward wholehearted sincerity. Do not reward naivety.

criteria.name: burden_of_proof_placement
criteria.text: burden-of-proof placement: how fairly the text assigns who must prove what. Reward burdens placed by reason. Penalize burdens quietly shifted onto the opponent.

criteria.name: gold_plating_avoidance
criteria.text: gold-plating avoidance: how well the text resists adding unrequested refinement to the already-sufficient. Reward the resisted plating. Distinguish craft pride from effort the outcome never needed.

criteria.name: leverage_point_targeting
criteria.text: leverage-point targeting: how well the text aims at the places where small changes shift the whole system — rules, goals, paradigms — rather than parameters. Reward the high-leverage aim. Penalize effort spent adjusting faucets on a structural problem.

criteria.name: intellectual_density

criteria.name: legibility_to_an_outsider

criteria.name: coiled_potential_energy
criteria.text: coiled potential energy: how much latent, not-yet-released force the text implies — a sense that something big could unfold from it. Reward pent tension and upside. Do not reward mere present size.

criteria.name: lock_in_caution
criteria.text: lock-in caution: how carefully the text treats choices that will be expensive to reverse once ecosystems form around them. Reward the flagged lock-in. Penalize standards set casually that harden forever.

criteria.name: seminar_room_register

criteria.name: adjacent_possible_instinct

criteria.name: need_to_be_right

criteria.text: elite-overproduction vibes: how much the text feels like surplus credentialed talent competing for too few positions — polish without a post. Score the surplus feel. Do not penalize polish itself.

criteria.name: self_containedness
criteria.text: self-containedness: how completely the text stands on its own — a reader needs no outside context, links, or prior knowledge to fully grasp it. Reward closure and sufficiency. Do not reward mere brevity.

criteria.name: high_status
criteria.text: high-status: how much the text signals membership in an elite or prestigious in-group — credentials, powerful affiliations, insider confidence. Reward markers of social rank. Do not reward the underlying quality of the work.

criteria.name: low_status
criteria.text: low-status: how much the text signals marginality or lack of social standing — hedging, outsider framing, apology, scrappiness. Reward markers of low rank. Do not reward genuine humility of a secure author.

criteria.name: rabbit_hole_discipline
criteria.text: rabbit-hole discipline: how well the text explores tangents with a rope tied to the entrance. Reward the bounded descent that returns with value. Penalize the exploration that becomes the destination unannounced.

criteria.name: bureaucratic_wildness
criteria.text: bureaucratic wildness: how much untamed creative energy survives inside procedural form — the wild thing filed in triplicate. Score the coexistence. Reward form channeling force, penalize either half alone.

criteria.name: fast_follower_realism
criteria.text: fast-follower realism: how honestly the text weighs letting others find the mines first. Reward the deliberate second position argued. Do not reward timidity dressed as strategy.

criteria.name: poshness
criteria.text: poshness: how upper-class, refined, or genteel the register feels — polished diction, understatement, cultivated taste. Reward refinement of manner. Do not reward wealth of subject matter alone.

criteria.name: technical_calmness
criteria.text: technical calmness: how composed and unhurried the technical voice is — precise, load-bearing claims stated without hype or anxiety. Reward serene mastery. Do not reward simplicity or lack of ambition.

criteria.name: earnestness
criteria.text: earnestness: how sincerely and un-ironically the text means what it says — direct conviction, absence of hedging distance or knowing winks. Reward wholehearted sincerity. Do not reward naivety.

criteria.name: graph_integrity
criteria.text: graph integrity: how honestly the figures represent the data — axes, scales, baselines. Reward the honest picture. Penalize truncation and aspect tricks that argue silently.

criteria.name: intensifier_inflation
criteria.text: intensifier inflation: how much very, extremely, and incredibly have devalued the text's currency. Penalize the inflation. The unintensified sentence is the stronger claim.

criteria.name: single_author_voice_clarity
criteria.text: single-author voice clarity: how unmistakably one mind is speaking. Reward the single throat. Do not reward idiosyncrasy performed to prove singularity.

criteria.name: intellectual_density
criteria.text: intellectual density: how many distinct load-bearing ideas per sentence — compression of real content, not padding. Reward idea-per-word richness. Do not reward jargon or long words.

criteria.name: legibility_to_an_outsider
criteria.text: legibility to an outsider: how easily a smart reader from outside the field grasps the point. Reward clarity across the boundary. Do not reward dumbing-down that loses the substance.

criteria.name: coiled_potential_energy
criteria.text: coiled potential energy: how much latent, not-yet-released force the text implies — a sense that something big could unfold from it. Reward pent tension and upside. Do not reward mere present size.

criteria.name: scarcity_theater
criteria.text: scarcity theater: how much limited availability is staged to force decisions. Penalize the staged scarcity. Do not penalize true constraints stated plainly.

criteria.name: appetite_for_disconfirming_evidence
criteria.text: appetite for disconfirming evidence: how eagerly the text seeks and engages the observations most dangerous to its thesis. Reward hunting falsifiers. Do not reward listing weak objections to seem thorough.

criteria.name: timelessness
criteria.text: timelessness: how well the text would read in fifty years — concerns and language that do not expire. Reward durable address. Do not reward antique styling.

criteria.name: craftedness
criteria.text: craftedness: how visibly the text was shaped with care — deliberate structure, chosen words, finished edges. Reward evident craft. Do not reward ornament for its own sake.

criteria.name: institutional_insiderness
criteria.text: institutional insiderness: how much the author writes from inside an established institution's norms and machinery. Reward fluency in the institutional idiom. Do not reward the institution's prestige itself.

criteria.name: how_much_it_rewards_a_careful_re_read
criteria.text: how much it rewards a careful re-read: how much additional meaning a second, slower reading yields. Reward layered depth. Do not reward obscurity that hides nothing.

criteria.name: larval_promise
criteria.text: larval promise: how much undeveloped capability the text shows — the shape of what this author will become. Score the visible potential. Reward it named as potential, not graded as achievement.

criteria.name: revenue_model_believability
criteria.text: revenue-model believability: how plausibly the text explains who pays, why, and how much. Reward the traced dollar. Penalize models where revenue is a later miracle.

criteria.name: capillary_pull
criteria.text: capillary pull: how much the text draws the reader onward through narrow spaces by its own adhesion. Reward the pull felt in the small passages. Do not reward suction toward nothing.

criteria.name: self_containedness
criteria.text: self-containedness: how completely the text stands on its own — a reader needs no outside context, links, or prior knowledge to fully grasp it. Reward closure and sufficiency. Do not reward mere brevity.

criteria.name: high_status
criteria.text: high-status: how much the text signals membership in an elite or prestigious in-group — credentials, powerful affiliations, insider confidence. Reward markers of social rank. Do not reward the underlying quality of the work.

criteria.name: low_status
criteria.text: low-status: how much the text signals marginality or lack of social standing — hedging, outsider framing, apology, scrappiness. Reward markers of low rank. Do not reward genuine humility of a secure author.

criteria.name: corrosion_resistance
criteria.text: corrosion resistance: how well the text withstands its environment over time — hostile commentary, shifting context, slow rust. Reward the resistant surface. Penalize claims that oxidize on exposure.

criteria.name: succession_planning
criteria.text: succession planning: how seriously the text prepares for its own leaders' replacement. Reward the named plan. Penalize institutions designed around one irreplaceable person.

criteria.name: triage_clarity
criteria.text: triage clarity: how decisively the text sorts what must be done now, later, and never. Reward the explicit triage with reasons. Penalize queues where everything is priority one.

criteria.name: poshness
criteria.text: poshness: how upper-class, refined, or genteel the register feels — polished diction, understatement, cultivated taste. Reward refinement of manner. Do not reward wealth of subject matter alone.

criteria.name: technical_calmness
criteria.text: technical calmness: how composed and unhurried the technical voice is — precise, load-bearing claims stated without hype or anxiety. Reward serene mastery. Do not reward simplicity or lack of ambition.

criteria.name: earnestness
criteria.text: earnestness: how sincerely and un-ironically the text means what it says — direct conviction, absence of hedging distance or knowing winks. Reward wholehearted sincerity. Do not reward naivety.

criteria.name: references_offered_unprompted
criteria.text: references offered unprompted: how readily the text volunteers ways to verify through others. Reward the unprompted referral. Do not reward reference lists curated to friendlies.

criteria.name: chekhov_gun_discipline
criteria.text: chekhov-gun discipline: how much every introduced element eventually fires. Reward the kept inventory. Penalize both the unfired arsenal and guns produced from nowhere in act three.

criteria.name: bridge_building_patience
criteria.text: bridge-building patience: how much slow trust-building across divides the text demonstrates or invests in. Reward the patient bridge. Penalize unity declared without the work.
